{{Top|leg}}
The '''Turntable''' was the dance floor located within the [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. It was continuously moving, spinning slowly enough to allow patrons to step on and off safely. However, it was fast enough that it could cause dancers to stumble and fall if they were not paying sufficient attention.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
